description: This file serves as the entry point for the Notes frontend application. It imports the Lightning.js framework and the main App component, then configures and launches the application with specific settings such as window size and key mappings.

methods.name: Blits.Launch
methods.description: Initializes and starts the Lightning.js application with the specified component, identifier, and configuration options.

calls: Blits.Launch(App, 'app', { w: 1920, h: 1080, keys: { up: ['ArrowUp'], down: ['ArrowDown'], left: ['ArrowLeft'], right: ['ArrowRight'], enter: ['Enter'], back: ['Escape'], delete: ['Delete', 'Backspace'], any: 'Any' } })
